entities.name: Jānis Ikaunieks
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jānis Ikaunieks was a Latvian astronomer, who studied the characteristics of the red giants, and, in particular carbon stars. He founded the Latvian Astronomical Society and the popular science magazine The Starry Sky and was the first director of the Baldone Observatory at Baldone near Riga, Latvia.
